arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test more thoroughly
r = parse.parse('hello {}', 'hello world')
print(f'result.fixed type: {type(r.fixed)}')
print(f'\"world\" in r.fixed: {\"world\" in r.fixed}')  # This is why it works!

# Now test R7 findall case sensitivity
print()
print('=== R7 findall case sensitivity ===')
results = list(parse.findall('{}', 'SPAM spam SPAM'))
print(f'case_sensitive not specified (default False): {len(results)} results')
for i, r in enumerate(results):
    print(f'  {i}: {r}')

results_cs = list(parse.findall('{}', 'SPAM spam SPAM', case_sensitive=True))
print(f'case_sensitive=True: {len(results_cs)} results')
"
